title: Discord is ditching Electron and its new app uses less RAM

claims.claim: Discord, masaüstü uygulamasını Electron framework'ünden Rust programlama diline taşıyor.

evidence.quote: Discord is finally giving up on Electron, the cross-platform framework that lets developers build desktop apps using web technologies. Electron web apps are notoriously heavy on system resources, and Discord is now moving its desktop app fully to Rust

Discord is finally giving up on Electron, the cross-platform framework that lets developers build desktop apps using web technologies. Electron web apps are notoriously heavy on system resources, and Discord is now moving its desktop app fully to Rust — a modern programming language designed for speed and memory safety.

claims.claim: Discord, 2018 yılından beri Rust teknolojisini erken benimseyen bir şirket olmuştur.

evidence.quote: “We’ve been early adopters of Rust since 2018

“We’ve been early adopters of Rust since 2018 and a lot of our infra, voice tech, and even some of the current client is already Rust, the holy grail was getting the whole client there,” explains Discord chief technology officer Stanislav Vishnevskiy in a post on X.

claims.claim: Discord'un altyapısının, ses teknolojisinin ve mevcut istemcisinin bir kısmında halihazırda Rust kullanılmaktadır.

evidence.quote: a lot of our infra, voice tech, and even some of the current client is already Rust

“We’ve been early adopters of Rust since 2018 and a lot of our infra, voice tech, and even some of the current client is already Rust, the holy grail was getting the whole client there,” explains Discord chief technology officer Stanislav Vishnevskiy in a post on X.

claims.claim: Discord CTO'su Stanislav Vishnevskiy, Electron ve React Native'in kullanımdan kaldırılacağını açıklamıştır.

evidence.quote: “That means Electron goes away, and so does React Native
“That means Electron goes away, and so does React Native, mobile keeps native UI but shares app code with desktop via Rust.”

claims.claim: Discord'un yeni Rust tabanlı Windows istemcisi 290MB RAM kullanmaktadır.

evidence.quote: Vishnevskiy also shared an image of the Discord Windows client using just 290MB of RAM

Vishnevskiy also shared an image of the Discord Windows client using just 290MB of RAM, which is a clear improvement as you only have to participate in a few servers and RAM usage can easily hit 1GB or more using the current Windows app.

claims.claim: Mevcut Discord Windows uygulaması, birkaç sunucuya katılım durumunda 1GB veya daha fazla RAM tüketebilmektedir.

evidence.quote: you only have to participate in a few servers and RAM usage can easily hit 1GB or more using the current Windows app.

Vishnevskiy also shared an image of the Discord Windows client using just 290MB of RAM, which is a clear improvement as you only have to participate in a few servers and RAM usage can easily hit 1GB or more using the current Windows app.

claims.claim: Discord, mobil uygulamalarında yerel kullanıcı arayüzünü korurken, masaüstü ile uygulama kodunu Rust üzerinden paylaşacaktır.

evidence.quote: mobile keeps native UI but shares app code with desktop via Rust.
“That means Electron goes away, and so does React Native, mobile keeps native UI but shares app code with desktop via Rust.”

claims.claim: Discord CTO'su Stanislav Vishnevskiy, yeni uygulamanın yakında kullanıcılarla test edilmeye başlanacağını belirtmiştir.

evidence.quote: Vishnevskiy says the company “hope to get it into testing with users soon.”
It’s not clear when Discord will make the full switch over to Rust, but Vishnevskiy says the company “hope to get it into testing with users soon.”
